I am a 52-year-old farmer in Mwanza with a 0.85-hectare rice plot. Here in the Lake Zone, chemical fertilizer is too expensive and hard to find for most of us, so I will not buy it for this field. But I keep cattle, and I will spread some manure on this plot before planting to help the soil. I will use my own saved rice seed as I have done for many years, and my family will do most of the work—we expect about 75 days of labor on this field between planting, weeding, and harvesting. I will hire about 20 days of extra help for the heavy work of land preparation and harvesting, since I have other plots to manage too.
